title: beehiiv Subscription
description: Schema for a beehiiv newsletter subscription resource as returned and accepted by the beehiiv v2 REST API (https://api.beehiiv.com/v2). Represents a single subscriber to a publication.

id.description: Prefixed identifier of the subscription (e.g. sub_xxxxxxxxxxxx).

publication_id.description: Prefixed identifier of the publication this subscription belongs to (e.g. pub_xxxxxxxxxxxx).

created.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the subscription was created.

subscription_tier.description: Tier of the subscription; free or a paid tier identifier.

subscription_premium_tier_names.description: Names of paid tiers the subscriber holds.

utm_source.description: UTM source captured at subscription time.

utm_medium.description: UTM medium captured at subscription time.

utm_campaign.description: UTM campaign captured at subscription time.

utm_channel.description: Channel that produced the subscription (e.g. organic, paid, referral).

referring_site.description: Referring URL captured at subscription time.

referral_code.description: Referral code used at subscription time, if any.

custom_fields.description: Custom field name/value pairs attached to this subscriber.

value.description: Custom field value (string, number, boolean, or date).
